articles.title: Crypto IPO boom stalls as AI frenzy reshapes tech markets, says Fundstrat exec
articles.snippet: Crypto firms are pausing long-awaited IPO plans as weak trading volumes and macro pressures weigh on valuations despite boom in AI-linked tech listings.

articles.title: Bitcoin treads water near pivotal monthly close while speculative tokens retreat
articles.snippet: Bitcoin held near $76,800 as altcoins weakened, WLFI slid and traders watched whether the largest cryptocurrency can hold Tom Lee's line in the sand.

articles.title: A DeFi exchange becomes the first to offer equity perpetuals powered by Nasdaq data
articles.snippet: The partnership underscores both the rapid growth of equity perpetuals in onchain markets and Nasdaq’s broader strategy to support tokenized equity trading infrastructure.

articles.title: XRP price risks 50% drop despite 9-day ETF inflow streak
articles.snippet: Spot XRP ETFs record net inflows for nine days, absorbing sell pressure and potentially supporting an XRP price recovery over time.

articles.title: Bitcoin price stays under $77K as US bond yields near 20-year highs
articles.snippet: BTC price stayed pinned below $77,000 amid rising US bond yields and oil prices, with market analysts saying Bitcoin is now at a "crucial level of support."
